name: quiz_quality_review

decisions.accept: Factually sound, unique correct answer, readable, difficulty plausible and no revealing cues
decisions.regenerate: Definite error: factual falsehood, no unique key, material language corruption, or answer leak
decisions.escalate: Genuine uncertainty or source-dependent claim; do not invent a definitive key

checks.description: Verify question premises and independently solve each option before looking at supplied key.
Ensure exactly one supported correct choice and no missing correct option.
Check requested language throughout question and options; detect mixed scripts, nonexistent names and corrupted terms.
Detect actual lexical/semantic giveaway of key; explanatory clues alone are not automatically answer_leak.
Difficulty 0 trivial, 5 general knowledge, 10 advanced, 15 expert specialist; tolerate normal variance.
Reject invented, absurd, redundant, duplicate or implausibly easy alternatives.
Distinguish paintings from sculptures, theories from facts and other category mismatches.
Ordered facts, four-option evaluation, localization, leakage, difficulty and calibrated verdict; applied in v1.1 system instructions.

evaluation.gold_only: Only adjudicated examples count in scoring. Provisional examples are excluded.

warning: Labels are provisional human-assistant assessments, not externally fact-checked adjudications. Revisit before treating corpus as certification.
role_experiment: editorial role prefix only; existing review procedure and output schema unchanged
